messages.author: 8b9a193f27c3b019
messages.subject: Covariate does not match 'values' ## times.
parts:
Hi all,

I have a error in inla(); "f(i). Covariate does not match 'values' ## times. Indexes for mismatch:70 71 72 73 74 75 ・・・. This is not what you want. Use NA values in the covariate!"
I do not know the meaning and the solution of this error, so I want any helps and advices if you know the solutions.
The code I run is follow.

Bests,
Yuki


=====code=====
data = read.csv("data.csv") # contains lon, lat, year, and fish abundance

# for spatio-temporal model
data$time = data$year-(min(data$year)-1) #time is from 1
data$w = factor(data$year) #for fixed effect (categorical variable)
k = 12 # time dimension

# location
lonlat = as.matrix(cbind(data$lon, data$lat))

# create a mesh with boundary
bound1 = inla.nonconvex.hull(lonlat, convex = 0.05, concave = -0.15)
mesh1 = inla.mesh.2d(boundary = bound1, max.edge = c(0.04, 0.04), cutoff = 0.08/5)
plot(mesh1)
points(lonlat, col = "red", pch = 16, cex = .5)

# spde
spde = inla.spde2.pcmatern(mesh = mesh1, alpha = 2, prior.range = c(0.01, 0.05), prior.sigma = c(1, 0.01))

# index
# confirmed that n.spde = mesh$n*time
iset = inla.spde.make.index("i", n.spde = spde$n.spde, n.group = k)

# projection matrix
A = inla.spde.make.A(mesh1, loc = lonlat, group = data$time)
dim(A) #9894, 2116
table(rowSums(A > 0))
table(rowSums(A))
table(colSums(A) > 0)

# stack
sdat = inla.stack(
  data = list(y = data$fish),
  A = list(A, 1),
  effects = list(iset, w = data$w),
  tag = "stdata"
)

# AR1
h.spec = list(theta = list(prior = "pccor1", param = c(0, 0.9)))

# model
formulae = y ~ 0 + w + f(i, model = spde, group = i.group, 
                         control.group = list(model = 'ar1', hyper = h.spec))
prec.prior = list(prior = "pc.prec", param = c(1, 0.01))

# fitting
# I got a error here
res = inla(formulae, 
           data = inla.stack.data(sdat), 
           control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE, A = inla.stack.A(sdat)),
           control.family = list(hyper = list(theta = prec.prior)),
           control.fixed = list(expand.factor.strategy = "inla"))

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Covariate does not match 'values' ## times.
parts:
A few things to check for debugging:
What’s mesh$n.spde ?
What’s range(iset$i) ?
What’s summary(inla.stack.data(sdat)$i) ?
Try setting ngroup=k in the f(i, ...) specification.

Finn
